rejected_by_review.name: Bursa
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Bursa/TR — a city of ~3M. Turkish provinces carry their capital's name and dr5hn's TR city list names districts, not the central one, so the gazetteer could not demote it.

rejected_by_review.name: Tucumán
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Tucumán/AR — the province, but 'Tucumán' is everyday shorthand for its capital San Miguel de Tucumán. Attested both ways.

rejected_by_review.name: Thurrock
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Thurrock/GB — unitary authority with no town of that name, but used as a place name in everyday speech. Low value, permanent risk.

rejected_by_review.name: Lewisham
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Lewisham/GB — London borough. An inhabited locality people give as a birthplace; belongs in the district discussion, not here.

rejected_by_review.name: Saint Thomas
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Saint Thomas/VI — the USVI district, but 'Saint Thomas' also names real cities elsewhere (St. Thomas, Ontario). Ambiguous.

rejected_by_review.name: Kohtla-Järve
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Kohtla-Järve — a real Estonian city filed under country_id=RU. That is the wrong-country repair, not a non-place.

rejected_by_review.name: Wandsworth
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Wandsworth/GB — London borough, same as Lewisham.

rejected_by_review.name: Malatya
rejected_by_review.review_reason: Malatya/TR — same shape as Bursa: real city, province named after it.
